summary.text: Christopher Salmon is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Sullivan 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An artist and glassblower, he says his central proposal is to lower local property taxes by funding special education from statewide sources.

paragraphs.text: Christopher Salmon graduated from Midland High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Goddard College in 1974.
Ballotpedia lists his career as artist, and in a Ballotpedia survey he said he continues to work as a glassblower and has done so since age 17.
He said he volunteered as an emergency medical technician on his town's ambulance for 41 years, served as a past captain, and has taught in both public and private schools.

In the survey, Salmon said New Hampshire's method of funding special education is a problem and that moving its cost off local school property taxes to statewide sources through a commission would lower local property taxes and reduce redundant administration.
